findings.label: Hardcoded team passcodes
findings.description: Team login passwords (gt123, ml123, etc.) are embedded in WorkCoreViewModel.kt and visible in the compiled APK. Move these to Firestore or a secure remote configuration so they can be updated without recompiling.

findings.label: Empty employee passwords
findings.description: All seed data employees have password = "" (empty string). No per-employee password protection exists. Token-based auth via Firebase is sufficient for current needs, but document this design constraint clearly for future password authentication layers.

findings.label: Team password field storage inconsistency
findings.description: TeamEntity.teamPassword is marked in comments as 'not stored in the local database' but the code attempts to read team.teamPassword in validation logic. Clarify whether team credentials live in Firestore only or are stored in the Room database.
